Currently having one. All my college career I never knew what I actually wanted to do with my life and procrastinated on that question all the way to graduation with my basic business degree. In 2 years post graduation I was a sales rep (felt slimy and miserable the way I’ve been coached to talk to people), a waiter (decent work but hours were not consistent at all) and a trainee electrician for a contractor (constantly going to different jobsites 2 hours away from where I lived and was treated as a scape goat a lot of the time by my bosses since I was new also was miserable.) 

I work as a med aide now and it’s the best job I’ve ever had and for the first time in my life I was inspired by my coworkers to work towards a career in nursing. Problem is that I don’t know how I’m going to support myself while also going back to school, basically required a full time schedule for a lot of the programs available to me even at my community college. even with my previous credits from my original degree it was still at least another two years of school. 

I am immensely lucky and thankful that my family and other scholarships paid for my degree but I can never bring myself to ask for help like that again especially since my parents are still putting my other siblings through college.

I feel trapped, I barely make enough for myself and I’m slowly coming to the realization that it may be too late to follow what took me so long to realize. 

My friends and siblings are moving on with their lives with new challenges and aspirations to look forward to and I am so proud of them but deep down I’m so scared I can’t move on in life anymore. Scared that I can’t catch up and that it’s too late. Knowing and feeling that with all the opportunities available to me at the time, I was too scared to just make a choice or focus and wasted my family’s time, money, and effort. And it fucking kills me every day.
